stem.text: A person stands on the edge of a high cliff that is next to the sea. The person throws a stone vertically upwards. Air resistance acts on the stone.
The stone eventually hits the sea.
Which velocity–time graph best shows the motion of the stone from when it is released until it hits the sea?

A.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled velocity and the horizontal axis labelled time, origin marked 0; a straight line starts below the time axis and rises to the right.

B.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled velocity and the horizontal axis labelled time, origin marked 0; a curve starts below the time axis and rises, becoming less steep.

C.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled velocity and the horizontal axis labelled time, origin marked 0; a curve starts above the time axis, rises to a peak and falls to the time axis.

D.alt: Graph with the vertical axis labelled velocity and the horizontal axis labelled time, origin marked 0; a curve starts above the time axis, falls to the time axis, then rises again.
